text:
Don't believe those who tell you there will be infinite efficiency gains by adopting AI. It plateaued at about 80%. There is no way you can automate the last 20% of human work ever.

Why do I know? Because I literally let AI take care of 80% of my job and I cannot automate anymore. I run out of tasks that I can entrust to AI, I really need to look at the rest myself. There is a theoretical upper bound of AI efficiency gains.

comments.text: May be a slightly pedantic comment, but would it be more accurate to say that (for you at least) the max productivity gain is 5x. Did I understand correctly - 80% of your previous total time constituted tasks that are now done by AI?

replies.text: right... it should be 5x, not 80%. mental slip.

comments.text: I challenge the use of the term automation here. Scripts automate. I look at AI as my infinite (well, depends on who picks up the token bill) army of extremely smart junior engineers that i can deploy onto any task. No sense in measuring that as % of automation achieved.
Brother just admitted he automated 80% of his job and still kept the salary 😂
